docs.title: $ cat /etc/prerequisites.conf
docs.text:
Verify environment variables and device state before executing flash operations:

  • [✓] PLATFORM-TOOLS -- Verify latest Android SDK Platform-Tools are in $PATH.
  • [✓] BOOTLOADER -- Device bootloader state must be unlocked.
  • [✓] FIRMWARE -- Flash only from the latest official vendor MIUI/HyperOS baseline.
  • [!] STORAGE WIPE -- Formatting partition /data is mandatory for clean installations.
  • [✓] RECOVERY -- Execute flash sequence exclusively with the documented device recovery.

KERNEL LOCK: CUSTOM KERNELS UNSUPPORTED

Third-party custom kernels modify kernel binary signatures. Any bug reports filed under non-official kernel binaries will be closed without inspection.

docs.text: Release alerts and community diagnostics are hosted on the Telegram Release Channel. When reporting kernel panics or crashes, pipe logs via adb logcat -d > crash.log.

docs.title: $ run --step sideload-pipeline
docs.text:
# 1. Pipe ROM binary over USB
adb sideload rom.zip

# 2. Reboot device back into recovery
# In recovery: Advanced > Reboot to recovery

# 3. Sideload the matching GApps payload
adb sideload MindTheGapps-*.zip

# 4. Boot into system
adb reboot

INTEGRITY CONFLICT: DO NOT FLASH ON GAPPS-BUNDLED BUILDS

Do NOT attempt to sideload GApps onto builds that already bundle Google Services (such as YAAP or any build with pre-included GApps). Doing so will trigger init crashes and bootloops.

Error code lookups, panic recovery sequences, and USB transmission diagnostics.

docs.title: ERR_BOOTLOOP: Encryption / Stale Userdata Mismatch
docs.text:
Occurs when flashing across incompatible Android versions, switching trees without formatting partition /data, or flashing custom kernels.

Recovery Sequence: 

# 1. Trigger hardware interrupt into Recovery (Vol Up + Power)
# 2. Commit Factory Reset:
Recovery > Factory Reset > Format data / factory reset > Confirm
# 3. Commit system reboot:
Recovery > Reboot system now

docs.title: ERR_SIDELOAD_STATUS_1: Recovery Script Failure
docs.text:
Triggered when the recovery signature check fails, the download payload is truncated, or recovery version is mismatched.

Recovery Sequence: 

# 1. Verify zip checksum against build manifest:
sha256sum rom_package.zip

# 2. Verify platform-tools version:
adb version

# 3. Ensure recommended device recovery was flashed to boot partition:
fastboot flash boot boot.img

docs.title: $ adb logcat -d > crash.log
docs.text:
When requesting diagnostics in the community chat, capture and upload a clean terminal logcat:

# Pipe device buffer to file on PC
adb logcat -d > crash.log

docs.title: $ cat /etc/preflight_check.log
docs.text:
KERNEL WARNING: PERMANENT STORAGE WIPING

Backup all personal data to off-device storage before running format steps. Internal user data (/data) will be completely erased.

  • Clean Flash Rule: Mandatory when switching from MIUI/HyperOS or another ROM base.
  • Firmware Level: Must be on the latest official vendor MIUI release for your region.
  • Recovery Binary: Flash and execute exclusively using AOSP recovery.

HARDWARE INTERRUPTS: RECOVERY NAVIGATION

In AOSP recovery mode: use Volume Up / Down keys to change selector position, and Power to commit selection.

docs.title: [STEP 01] $ adb reboot bootloader
docs.text:
Power off the device and hold [Vol Down] + [Power], or run from terminal: 

adb reboot bootloader

docs.title: [STEP 02] $ fastboot flash boot boot.img
docs.text:
Flash the recommended recovery boot partition image: 

fastboot flash boot boot.img

docs.title: [STEP 03] $ fastboot reboot recovery
docs.text:
Reboot the device directly into the newly flashed recovery environment: 

fastboot reboot recovery

docs.title: [STEP 04] Recovery > Factory Reset > Format Data
docs.text:
In the AOSP recovery menu interface: 

Factory Reset > Format data / factory reset > Confirm

docs.title: [STEP 05] Recovery > Apply Update > Apply from ADB
docs.text:
In recovery menu, select: 

Apply update > Apply from ADB

docs.title: [STEP 06] $ adb sideload rom_package.zip
docs.text:
Pipe and flash the build package over USB: 

adb sideload rom_package.zip

docs.title: [STEP 07] $ fastboot reboot / Reboot System Now
docs.text:
When the transfer finishes (Total xfer: 1.00x), navigate to main recovery menu and select: 

Reboot system now
